findings.title: Synchronous connection.Open() and BeginTransaction() inside an async request path
findings.recommendation: Use DbConnection.OpenAsync(cancellationToken) and BeginTransactionAsync(cancellationToken) (typing the connection as DbConnection) so request threads are not blocked on network I/O.
